author: piztanza
description: Implement the Join Waitlist page + lead capture backend (F-007 + F-008) at /join per the approved design: split-screen brand panel + 4-step bilingual wizard (type-adaptive fields, inline validation, honeypot, slide transitions), POST /api/waitlist (zod validation, rate limit, drizzle insert into waitlist_leads with SQL migration, Resend email alert per the approved database+email decision, local JSONL fallback without DATABASE_URL), success panel with personalized copy and configurable WhatsApp deep link.
acceptance_criteria: Split-screen /join matches the design: dark brand panel (offer chip, H1, 3 benefits, trust line, floating sprites) + wizard card with progress bar; fully usable on mobile (stacked)

Wizard steps behave per design: type picker auto-advances; businessName label/placeholder adapt to type; tools chips shown only for GARAGE, brands input otherwise; slide transitions with per-step autofocus; all copy from the approved TXT map in both languages
Validation: businessName required; email/phone/WhatsApp format-checked only when filled; inline errors in the active language; honeypot rejected server-side with fake success

POST /api/waitlist persists the lead (drizzle insert; migration included) BEFORE the client shows success; per-IP rate limiting; zod length limits mirror the design's maxlengths; without DATABASE_URL leads append to a local JSONL so dev flow works
A Resend email alert with the lead's details goes to WAITLIST_ALERT_TO per submission; email failure after a successful insert still returns 200 and is logged; no fee figures in any template
Failed submits show a retriable bilingual error and preserve entered data
Success panel personalizes with the business name and builds the wa.me link from NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER (default 6281234567890) with the language-appropriate prefilled message
Suite stays green; new unit tests cover zod accept/reject, honeypot, wa.me builder, and en/id wizard key completeness
